purpose: pre-fix measurement for #274: Mesh2Motion probe dies on one Node/DOM line in three's GLTFLoader. Records install state, independent rig parse, and the exact probe failure — all measured BEFORE any product edit.

install.defaultPathInCode: /tmp/ocxr77_tools/mesh2motion-app (still the /tmp default — the durable ~/.openclinxr-tools path is not the default yet)

rigIndependentParse.note: rig has no textures; the failure surfaces on the humanoid fit because the Anny bodies ship 1 bufferView-embedded PNG each (peds_patient_child.glb: openclinxr_skin_micro_normal, 214738 bytes, image/png, bufferView, not URI).

probeFailure.reproducedOn: 2026-08-10, node v24.18.1, three 0.185.0 in the durable install
probeFailure.analysis: three r185 in Node picks TextureLoader (typeof createImageBitmap === 'undefined'), whose ImageLoader calls createElementNS('img') via document — so self alone is not sufficient; the load path additionally needs URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL (Node's URL lacks them; the humanoid texture is bufferView-embedded so blob->objectURL is taken) and a minimal document shim. Validated in a scratch repro (no product edit): shimming self + URL.createObjectURL + document.createElementNS returning an EventTarget img that fires 'load' lets the full probe complete with 66 bones and writes the probe report.
probeFailure.claimScope: structural comparison only; texture pixels are not decoded (no rendering claim)

cachedBlockedVerdict.note: absent by design in this worktree (gitignored); the known trap (probe returns prior status:blocked before checking the install path) did not apply on this run.
